$comment: Catalog of every character picture in <characters folder>/<file>. The pictures live in the private data-for-cartoons repo (see scripts/characters-dir.mjs); this catalog is committed here. Points are picture pixels; `anchor` names the point that becomes the rig's origin. Check with `npm run characters`.

Carrick.look: short brown hair greying at the sides, full beard; navy zip training top, navy trousers, black trainers

Bruno.look: curly dark hair, big ears, short beard; red United shirt, white shorts, red socks, black boots

Ole.who: Ole Gunnar Solskjær, former Manchester United manager
Ole.look: grey swept hair, cheeky grin; long charcoal coat over a dark top, dark trousers, black shoes

Klopp.look: black cap, glasses, beard, big grin; red puffer gilet over black, black trousers

Ronaldo.look: short dark hair with a quiff; red Portugal-style shirt with dark green trim and a yellow 7, dark green shorts, red socks, black boots, yellow captain's armband on his left upper arm

Kid.who: A young Portugal fan, about 8 (not a real person)
Kid.look: dark hair; oversized red number 7 shirt with dark green trim, dark green shorts, red socks, black boots

carrick_sitting.notes: No chair drawn: sits on any seat drawn in code. The four face pictures below are this exact pose with another face.

carrick_pain.face: eyes squeezed shut, gritted teeth, red cheeks

carrick_relief.face: eyes closed, blowing out a puff of air

carrick_panic.face: screaming, eyes wide, hair on end
carrick_panic.notes: Its head is also swapped onto the jump and launch pictures (see CarrickRig).

bruno_extinguisher.notes: Holding a red fire extinguisher at his chest. No spray drawn: spray is added in code from `nozzle`.

bruno_proud.notes: Hands on hips, extinguisher standing on the floor by his right foot.

ole_chair.notes: Folded camping chair under his arm. Flip with a negative scaleX to face left.

ole_eager.notes: Rubbing his hands together, folded chair standing beside him.

ole_seated.notes: Hands behind his head. No chair drawn: sits on any seat drawn in code.

klopp.notes: Hands behind his back. KloppRig (episodes/klopp-laughs) splits head and body at `neck` to make him laugh.

ronaldo_standing.notes: Arms hanging. Captain's armband on the arm on the right of the picture (box 700–825 × 1020–1165).

ronaldo_sad.notes: ronaldo_standing with another face, drawn 12 px further left.

ronaldo_smile.notes: ronaldo_standing with another face, drawn 10 px further left.

ronaldo_bare.notes: ronaldo_standing without the armband. RonaldoRig puts the sad and smile faces on it.

ronaldo_siuu_bare.body: mid-air jump, arms spread wide (siuu celebration)
ronaldo_siuu_bare.face: siuu: lips pushed far out in a simple skin-coloured pout with a dark round hole
ronaldo_siuu_bare.notes: No armband. Drawn smaller than ronaldo_standing: scale ×1.24 to match.

kid_standing.notes: Oversized shirt, no armband, hands at his sides (handL/handR = the hands on the left/right of the picture).

kid_siuu.body: mid-air jump, arms spread wide (siuu celebration)
kid_siuu.notes: Wears the captain's armband. Head drawn smaller than kid_standing: scale ×1.2 to match.
